environment: Playwright 1.64.1 / Chromium 156.0.8078.4 headless, macOS arm64 with SwiftShader; phone is the 390 x 844 touch-emulated project at device scale 2
fixture: Disposable in-memory family-mode household. Rowan (owner, adult), Ash (adult) and Wren (child) each sign in with their own virtual passkey. The real Channel3 merchant code runs over a fake transport (test/helpers/fit-catalog.mjs). That transport returns an invented "Tents (test fixture)" category whose "Sleeps (test fixture)" attribute lists 1, 2, 4 and 6 person, and eight invented products. Its search ignores every filter. The server day is Nov 8, 2026; the goal is $300.00 with $60.00 reported, $30.00 a week and a Dec 20 date; offers are Rowan $20.00 and Ash $10.00. None of this is Channel3’s live taxonomy.
spec: test/e2e/family-fit.spec.mjs — a family finds options that fit its needs and date, keeps why it chose one, and carries it into the family schedule
steps: Rowan tries a one-off $90.00 and chooses Find options that fit: the planning limit is $150.00 by Dec 20
Explicit look-ups: Find kinds of item (category search), then Show must-haves (category detail); Rowan accepts 4 or 6 person
Find options that fit: capture the two suggested tents and why each fits
A provider answer held until Ash changed his offer is refused; Ash restores it
A one-off $120.00 and another explicit search suggest tent A only (Dec 20); Rowan updates the family choice: capture its reason
Review this choice, then Save goal and propose this schedule, then Use this plan: capture the plan in use with its reason

images.story: With a one-off $90.00 tried, the planning limit is $150.00 by Dec 20. The adult chose the fixture kind "Tents (test fixture)" and the must-have "Sleeps (test fixture)": 4 person or 6 person. Two of eight checked items are suggested, each with why it fits: tent A $120.00 finishing Dec 13, and tent B $150.00 finishing Dec 20.
